diagnostic_steps.name: Step-1-Reconstruct
diagnostic_steps.purpose: Full Dirichlet constraint on DOFs 1, 2, and 3 preserves initial deformed state and prevents zero-displacement strain surge

diagnostic_steps.name: Step-2-Hold
diagnostic_steps.purpose: Unconstrained release of interior DOFs 1, 2 and phase-field DOF 3 (OP=NEW) with constant displacement hold
prescribed_dofs: Physical BCs: N_BOTTOM (uy=0), N_PIN (ux=0), N_TOP (ux=0), N_RP (uy=0.0050)
released_dofs: All interior mechanical DOFs 1, 2 and phase-field DOF 3
diagnostic_steps.time_stepping: 0.05, 1.0, 1.0e-6, 0.10 (up to 20 increments, allowing observation of first release increments)

gate_c1_equilibrium_residual_norm.name: Gate C1: Equilibrium Residual Norm
gate_c1_equilibrium_residual_norm.notes: Requires Abaqus standard.exe solver execution with UEL to evaluate Newton equilibrium residual norm.

gate_c2_reaction_force_parity.name: Gate C2: Recipient-versus-Donor Reaction Force Parity
gate_c2_reaction_force_parity.notes: Physical measurement requires post-release RF_2 on N_RP at Increment 1 of Step-2-Hold.

gate_c3_internal_energy_continuity.name: Gate C3: Total Internal Energy Continuity
gate_c3_internal_energy_continuity.notes: Physical measurement requires post-release UEL energy balance (ALLSE + ALLPD/E_frac) at Increment 1 of Step-2-Hold.

gate_c4_pointwise_damage_irreversibility.name: Gate C4: Pointwise Damage Irreversibility (No-Healing)
gate_c4_pointwise_damage_irreversibility.criterion: min(Delta d) >= -1.0e-4 across all 16,642 physical nodes
gate_c4_pointwise_damage_irreversibility.notes: Physical measurement requires comparing post-release nodal damage d at Increment 1 of Step-2-Hold against transferred d.

gate_c5_artificial_crack_tip_damage_cap.name: Gate C5: Artificial Crack-Tip Damage Increase Cap
gate_c5_artificial_crack_tip_damage_cap.notes: Physical measurement requires tracking crack-tip Node 14403 damage evolution during unconstrained release increments.
